description: Convert JSON to YAML (js-yaml dump: no line wrapping, no anchors; strings that would read as numbers/booleans are quoted). Options: 2 or 4 space indent, sort keys, and write a top-level array as a multi-document YAML stream (--- per item). Invalid JSON gives line and column. Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/yaml-json/

multiDocument.description: A top-level JSON array becomes one YAML document per item.

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a JSON file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

name: json_to_yaml
title: JSON to YAML
